description: This PHP file handles the display logic for the Detail View of a module in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving entity information, setting up Smarty template variables, handling permissions, related lists, and custom links.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class responsible for retrieving CRM entity instances based on module context.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper customized for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Class managing retrieval of custom links for modules.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks and returns feature buttons available for the current module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Determines the parent tab of the current module.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Fetches the display name(s) for an entity record.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves update information for a record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence field configuration for a module, if any.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation data for fields in a table.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into separate arrays for field names, types, and labels.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for actions on modules/records.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related list data for the current module and record.
